card.name: Error messages and warning headings
card.fires_on: Words inside fixed system error lines such as "No such file or directory", and words in warning headings such as "WARNINGS" or "WARNING: Accidental overdose of".

modes.label: File error text
modes.description: The words "such" or "file" in the stock message "No such file or directory" and nearby console output.
modes.example: ls -l /dev/cd1bls: /dev/cd1b: No<< such>> file or directory ls -l cd

modes.label: Label warning headings
modes.description: Words in boxed warning headings, such as the split of WARNINGS or "overdose of".
modes.example: WARNING: Accidental overdose<< of>> iron-containing products is a leading cause of
